retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for high-energy music covers featuring black silhouettes of a dancing crowd against a backdrop of explosive, radial light trails.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring a row of black human silhouettes in dancing poses, set against a background of intense, multi-colored radial light streaks that converge toward the top center. Bold, tightly-tracked geometric typography is layered over the lower third of the image.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouettes anchored to the bottom third, overlapping the light trails
Radial light streaks creating a sense of upward and outward motion
Large-scale typography integrated with the silhouette layer
High contrast between black foreground figures and neon background
coreInvariants: Solid black silhouettes of people with raised arms
Radial light trail background with pink, orange, and purple hues

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A horizontal line of dancing silhouettes occupies the middle and lower foreground, scaled to fill the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold 'dance' and 'party' text in the lower third serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the radial light trails from the top center down to the crowd, then across the large horizontal text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with light effects and figures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value in the background light trails against zero-value black silhouettes.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking (touching or overlapping characters)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'p' and 'd' as mirrored geometric forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast bold lowercase display text with smaller, wide-tracked uppercase metadata text.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules for metadata framing

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight-fitting capability.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant background of radial light trails in pink, purple, and orange bursting from the top center. In the foreground, place a row of solid black silhouettes of people dancing with their arms raised.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold geometric sans-serif text in the lower third. Use lowercase for the main title with characters touching. Add a secondary line of text in yellow and white. Place a small line of uppercase text inside a thin rectangular frame at the very top.

verificationChecks: Is the background composed of radial light streaks?
Is the main text lowercase and extra bold?
Are the letters in the main title touching each other?

mustRedesign: Do not use exact artist names from the reference
Ensure silhouettes are generic and not identifiable individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check that light trails converge toward a single point
Verify that text does not obscure the primary action of the silhouettes
Ensure the color palette remains vibrant and neon-focused
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the club atmosphere
recipe.reuseFormula: Crowd Silhouettes + Radial Light Trails + Geometric Bold Typography = High-Energy Club Aesthetic
